tickets.title: Screen debt refinance opportunity
tickets.text: Compare current loan terms with proposed terms, including rate, remaining term, closing costs, cash-flow impact, break-even period, and planning risks before recommending next steps. Prepare a side-by-side review of Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk's current adjustable mortgage (balance about $742,000, rate scheduled to reset in 2025) against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs.
tickets.evidence: Liora asked for a side-by-side review of the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-03.

tickets.title: Analyze mortgage reset timing
tickets.text: Analyze the mortgage servicer's notice showing the upcoming rate change window for Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk's adjustable mortgage (balance about $742,000) and deliver a recommendation early enough for them to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender.
tickets.evidence: the household wants a recommendation early enough to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-30.

tickets.title: Collect complete HELOC statement
tickets.text: Obtain the missing pages of the HELOC statement for Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk, including the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language, since the portal file contains only a partial statement and these terms are needed to model the combined debt picture (HELOC balance about $96,000).
tickets.evidence: the portal file contains only a partial HELOC statement, and the missing pages include the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-20.

tickets.title: Reconcile escrow and budget figures
tickets.text: Reconcile the mortgage servicer's escrow estimate with Liora Nettlewhisk's household budget, which show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, to resolve the uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset.
tickets.evidence: the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, creating uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-27.

tickets.title: Resolve duplicate HELOC autopay draft
tickets.text: Follow up with Teacup Comet Bank on the duplicate HELOC autopay draft in one cycle that temporarily reduced the Nettlewhisks' checking cushion (about $38,500 combined checking and savings) and forced a transfer from savings before payroll posted, and confirm protections against a repeat draft.
tickets.evidence: Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-21.

tickets.title: Review debt repayment funding options
tickets.text: Review selling enough Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares from Liora Nettlewhisk's taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody (about $412,000) to pay off the $11,200 credit card balance and part of the $28,400 auto loan, evaluating tax lots that vary significantly by holding period and unrealized gain and the concentration-risk reduction.
tickets.evidence: selling enough Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to pay off the credit card balance and part of the auto loan could reduce concentration risk, but the tax lots vary significantly by holding period and unrealized gain; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-10.
